title: Sindh Buildings Control Second Amendment Act 1990

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Buildings Control Second Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1990
ACT VII OF 1990
SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
Are Act further to amend the Sindh Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 23rd December, 1990]
No. PAS/Legis-B-4/90, dated
23-12-1990.--The Sindh Buildings Control (Second Amendment) Bill, 1990 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 20th November, 1990 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on the 4th December, 1990 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Buildings Control
(Second Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from the 27th August, 1990.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Buildings Control Second Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6 of Sindh Ordinance V of 1979

ACT VII OF 1990
ACT VII OF 1990
SINDH BUILDINGS CONTROL (SECOND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
Are Act further to amend the Sindh Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 23rd December, 1990]
No. PAS/Legis-B-4/90, dated
23-12-1990.--The Sindh Buildings Control (Second Amendment) Bill, 1990 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 20th November, 1990 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on the 4th December, 1990 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 6 of
Sindh Ordinance V of 1979: -In the Sindh Buildings Control Ordinance, 1979,
in section 6, after subsection (4), the following new subsections and
Explanation shall be added:--
"(5) At any time after a
no-objection certificate has been issued under subsection (1) but before the
completion of building, Government may, if it is satisfied that the
construction of any type of building or buildings in any area is not in the
public interest or is otherwise inexpedient, notwithstanding anything contained
in this Ordinance, rules or regulations made thereunder and without notice
suspend or cancel the certificate.
Explanation:--The expression
"completion of building" used in this subsection means.. the
completion of building in all respects according to the approved plan and in
respect whereof occupancy certificate has been issued.
(6) Where any order is passed
under subsection (5), the matter shall be reprocessed by the Authority in
accordance with such directions as may be given by Government."
